title: LatentLens: Rethinking Latent Interface in Multi-Agent Systems
abstract: arXiv:2611.31582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Latent interfaces let agents in a multi-agent system communicate through continuous representations rather than decoded text. Prior work reports performance and efficiency gains, but neither separates latent communication from the agent harness nor examines its internal components, leaving its actual contribution unclear. We propose LatentLens, a framework that decouples the latent interface at two levels: externally from the agent harness, to measure its contribution to overall performance (RQ1), and internally into realignment compatibility, information accessibility, and propagation dynamics, to identify the benefits and limitations of each (RQ2). Across seven benchmarks with Qwen3 models, adding the latent interface to the same harness does not improve and can even substantially degrade accuracy. translated_title: LatentLens：重新思考多智能体系统中的潜在接口
translated_abstract: 潜在接口使多智能体系统中的智能体能够通过连续表示而非解码后的文本进行通信。先前的研究报告了性能和效率上的提升，但既没有将潜在通信与智能体框架（harness）分离开来，也没有考察其内部组件，导致其实际贡献尚不明确。我们提出了LatentLens，一个在两个层面解耦潜在接口的框架：在外部将其与智能体框架解耦，以衡量其对整体性能的贡献（RQ1）；在内部将其解耦为重新对齐兼容性、信息可访问性和传播动态，以识别各因素的优势与局限（RQ2）。在基于Qwen3模型的七个基准测试中，在相同的智能体框架上添加潜在接口并不能提升性能，甚至可能显著降低准确率。在内部，潜在表示保留了一定的领域信息，但不兼容的重新对齐可能大幅降低性能。
tldr: 本文提出LatentLens框架，从外部和内部两个层面解耦多智能体系统中的潜在接口，发现在相同智能体框架下引入潜在接口并不能提升甚至可能显著降低性能，其效果取决于重新对齐兼容性、信息可访问性和传播动态等内部因素。
en_tdlr: LatentLens decouples the latent interface in multi-agent systems both externally from the agent harness and internally into its components, revealing that adding the latent interface to the same harness does not improve—and can substantially degrade—accuracy, with its benefits contingent on realignment compatibility.
